morning_digest.note: Pacific time via America/Los_Angeles in scheduler. timezone_offset_hours is legacy, not used for window math. catch_up_hours: send if not yet sent today and now is between scheduled time and this many hours after.

lead_alert.note: creation_date_threshold_days: contacts older than this are never treated as new leads on peopleUpdated. last_activity_window_seconds: freshness gate for peopleUpdated. events_rate_limit_per_10s: max GET /events calls per sliding 10-second window (FUB limit is about 20).
